name: turbulence_normalisation
description: Double wavenumber integral of Phi_ww equals w_rms^2 (von Karman and Liepmann)

name: wake_envelope_energy
description: Periodic Gaussian wake envelope: sum |E_m|^2 equals the passage-averaged mean square w_c^2 (Lw/s) sqrt(pi/ln2)

name: te_radiation_integral
description: Roger & Moreau closed-form I1 equals the chordwise integral of Amiet's scattered pressure plus the incident field continued into the wake

name: le_response_limits
description: Leading-edge response: |L| -> 1/beta (compressible Sears) as K -> 0; high/low-frequency branches within 2 dB at Amiet's switch

name: gep_zero_pressure_gradient
description: VKI GEP model reproduces Goody's ZPG spectrum at mid frequencies (0.2 < omega delta*/Ue < 5)

name: rozenberg_zpg_limit
description: Rozenberg's model reduces to Goody's at zero pressure gradient (Delta = 8, low/mid frequency)

name: le_velocity_scaling
description: Leading-edge noise of the Paterson & Amiet airfoil scales as U^5 - U^6 (50-60 dB per decade)
metric: deviation of the slope from [50, 60] dB/decade

name: te_velocity_scaling
description: Trailing-edge noise of the BPM airfoil scales close to U^5 (45-55 dB per decade)
reference: Ffowcs Williams & Hall (1970); Brooks, Pope & Marcolini (1989)
metric: deviation of the slope from [45, 55] dB/decade

name: doppler_kinematics
description: Compact rotating dipole with power-law spectra: the simplified formulation with the (w_s/w)^2 Doppler factor (reception-time observer) reproduces the exact Bessel-series result for w >> Omega
reference: Blandeau & Joseph (2011) AIAA J 49; Sinayoko, Kingan & Agarwal (2013) Proc. R. Soc. A 469

name: full_vs_simplified
description: Rotating flat plate at relative Mach 0.6: full and simplified (Amiet) formulations agree above ~15 shaft orders for LE and TE noise, static and in flight
reference: Blandeau & Joseph (2011) AIAA J 49(5); Blandeau (2011) ch. 3-4

name: low_frequency_departure
description: Below ~3 shaft orders the formulations differ by a bounded amount (0.1-6 dB): the simplified model is not exact there, and the full model stays smooth (no hydrodynamic-coincidence spikes from evanescent modes)

name: blade_count
description: Uncorrelated blades: doubling B adds 3.01 dB

name: thesis_eq318_vs_eq57
description: Thesis eq. 3.18 (exact BRTE) and eq. 5.7 (Amiet's approximate model) agree above ~15 shaft orders, as concluded in the thesis' chapter 5
reference: Blandeau (2011) eqs. 3.18, 5.7 and ch. 5; Blandeau & Joseph (2011) AIAA J 49(5)

name: thesis_eq318_vs_full
description: Thesis eq. 3.18 with the Doppler shift paired as omega - l Omega agrees with the independent full formulation (same Corcos scale, Uc, no back-scattering); the residual comes from the thesis' 1/(b|kX| + b|kappa|) chordwise factor

name: rozenberg2010_zpg_limit
description: Thesis eq. 3.27 (Rozenberg 2010) reduces to Goody's model at zero pressure gradient with delta = 8 delta*

name: te_subcritical_gusts
description: Trailing-edge response stays finite and continuous for subcritical gusts (ky > mubar beta, reached by the full formulation in flight): no jump across the critical gust and no growth beyond it
